newsitem.title: ITALY: Pope leaves Rome for two-day Hungary visit. [CORRECTED 08:13 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Pope leaves Rome for two-day Hungary visit. [CORRECTED 08:13 GMT]

text.p: Pope John Paul left Rome on Friday for a two-day trip to Hungary.
The 76-year-old Pontiff flew from Rome's Fiumicino airport to Hungary, (corrects from "Ciampino airport") to mark the 1,000th anniversary of a Benedictine monastery at Pannonhalma in western Hungary.
He will also celebrate mass in the nearby city of Gyor, on the river Danube, and meet Hungarian bishops before returning to Rome on Saturday evening.
The trip, the Pope's 73rd abroad, follows a fresh scare about his health in mid-August when he complained about abdominal pain and entered hospital briefly for a series of medical tests.
The Vatican said the tests were part of a regular series since surgery for a colon tumor in 1992 and showed nothing noteworthy.
